---
name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaVoice MVP slice around transcription synthesis diarization or audio analysis with measurable acceptance criteria. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an already-approved feature or claiming production readiness.
---

# Product scope

- Start from the capabilities and Beta criteria declared in `README.md`.
- Choose one authorized audio use case and one reproducible input fixture.
- Define expected output quality latency language and hardware assumptions when relevant.
- State consent privacy and voice-right constraints explicitly.
- Keep voice cloning or unauthorized third-party processing out of scope.
- Require a reproducible example test and documented limitation before marking the slice complete.
